tools.name: search
tools.title: Search MCP servers by intent
tools.description: Hybrid (keyword + semantic) search over servers and their tools. Filter by connection class to keep only what you can reach autonomously (R0, R1).

tools.name: get_server
tools.title: Get a server descriptor
tools.description: Official server.json plus connectability (class, remotes with auth/health, packages), current tools, trust breakdown and identity for one server name.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.title: List a server's tools
tools.description: Every current tool of a server with full input/output schemas, paginated by tool name.

tools.name: get_connection
tools.title: Get a connection block
tools.description: Minimal connection block for the preferred remote (or package) with ${SECRET} placeholders, formatted for a target client. Secrets are never accepted or returned.

tools.name: check_server
tools.title: Check an MCP server URL
tools.description: Probe a remote MCP server URL once, credential-free and without calling its tools, and get its quality checks and its readiness for the Claude and OpenAI directories. Pass `url` to start a check (waits up to 25 s for the result), or `id` to read one. Quota: a few checks per hour anonymously, more with an API key.

probe.instructions:
protogrid: registry of MCP servers from the official registry, probed without credentials.
Flow: search(q) → get_server(name) or list_tools(name) → get_connection(name, target) → connect with your client.
check_server(url) probes any MCP server URL once: quality and Claude and OpenAI directory readiness.
Classes: R0 no auth; R1 a static secret (${NAME} placeholders); R2 OAuth, one human consent; L0 local package.
Results carry next_actions with arguments. Scores are observed signals, not audits.
